notes.title: 🎹 Steam Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hello!



The Steam demo has been released! If you're familiar with the web demo, it has 2 extra levels and some bug fixes! (Also something extra hidden in there). I've updated the build on other platforms as well.

Please enjoy! Let me know if you run into any problems with it~

If you want monthly updates on what I'm working on, please join the mailing list or join the discord!

I set up a specific forum for sharing beats in here, for anything else you can do that in the general discussion forum. If you want to see beats people have made so far, there is also a forum thread on the game's itch page that people were using up until now. I'm planning to just have two main places for the shared beats, the Steam forum and the itch thread, but you can share them anywhere.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45254696/3fbb2392aa4ce1223c087261f9c98dc67db52806.png"]

I was originally planning to add achievements to this demo, but after looking into it more, I decided on this:

The achievements will be in the full game, but the save file will sync between the two. So if you get the full game, any achievements you've completed in the demo will be unlocked in the full game. 

(Because of how demos work achievements can't be shared between the demo and the full game).



The main changes to this demo (from the web version) are:

2 new levels

Fixed random beat sharing

Switched .mp3 recording to .wav recording (Although the file sizes are bigger the quality is better and it works better across different platforms)

Something extra



Thanks!

notes.title: 🎹 Sign up to try the playtest version! (24 levels)
notes.notes:
Hello!

I'm planning to run a playtest with the 24 level version of the game within the next week or so. If you want to try that version please sign up to my mailing list. I also send out monthly newsletters here.

I think I will send out the download links around New Year's Day or the weekend after, but it may be a little later. I do this to get feedback on the current version of the game. Please don't share any screenshots or videos from this version of the  game publicly & please consider filling out the feedback form when you're done!

I think this will most likely be the last time I send out playtest versions of the game as it's getting pretty close to the complete version of the game. But there might be a few more times, depending on how things go.

I'm looking forward to hearing what you think!

Thanks!
